help_radio: The stick needs the OpenThread RCP firmware (radio co-processor). Most sticks come with Zigbee firmware and have to be flashed first. A stick can be used by one program only: Zigbee and Thread need one stick each.
Serial port of the Thread stick: Serial port of the Thread stick
help_serialPort: Use the stable name below /dev/serial/by-id: it does not change when the stick is plugged in again
help_baudRate: Must match the firmware of the stick, usually 460800
help_flowControl: Must match the firmware of the stick. Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1 (SkyConnect): hardware
Run the OpenThread Border Router in Dock: Run the OpenThread Border Router in Docker (managed by this adapter)
help_docker: Needs Docker on a Linux host. Without Docker the adapter can use an existing border router.
REST API of an existing border router: REST API of an existing border router
help_externalUrl: Address of the REST API of otbr-agent, e.g. of the OpenThread Border Router add-on of Home Assistant
help_infraInterface: Interface of the Docker host to the LAN (e.g. eth0 or wlan0), detected on the first start
Prepare the host (IPv6 forwarding, route: Prepare the host (IPv6 forwarding, router advertisements)
help_prepareHost: The container enables IPv6 forwarding and the acceptance of router advertisements with routes on the LAN interface of the host. Disable it if you configure the host yourself.
help_image: Empty: the release of OpenThread tested with this version of the adapter. Another image only if the firmware of the stick fits to it
help_autoUpdate: Only for an image with a tag, e.g. openthread/border-router:latest. A new otbr-agent may need a new firmware on the stick
Stop the container when the instance sto: Stop the container when the instance stops
help_stopOnUnload: Usually not: the Matter devices need the Thread network also when the instance is stopped
help_restBind: The REST API has no password and contains the network key. Open it to the network only if another system needs it.
help_restPort: Not 8081: that port is used by ioBroker admin
Web interface of OTBR reachable from: Web interface of OTBR reachable from
Create a Thread network automatically if: Create a Thread network automatically if the border router has none
help_autoCreate: Network key, PAN ID and extended PAN ID are generated randomly
help_channel: Automatic: 25, 15 or 20 (between the Wi-Fi channels), not the channel of a Zigbee instance
help_matter: ioBroker.matter needs the credentials of the Thread network (dataset) to add Thread devices. The adapter hands them over automatically whenever the network changes.
